verification_log.method: Fetched and read the commentary on Daniel 8

No BC date for the third year; Daniel in Shushan on the king's business (8:27); ram = Media and Persia (Persia higher, later); goat = Greece, great horn = Alexander; four horns = Cassander, Lysimachus, Seleucus, Ptolemy; little horn = Antiochus IV as near fulfillment and the Antichrist as far (dual); prefers 2,300 days (171–165 BC, cleansing 25 Dec 165) and notes Newell's 1,150 days (168–165); rejects William Miller's year-day 1844 reckoning; John 10:22
